name: YuE2
summary: A full song from a style and a lyric sheet, with YuE2: sung vocals and the band in one pass, verse and chorus.

source.notes: The user workflow converted with tools/ui2api.py (its pipeline lives in a subgraph, so the nodes keep the 33: prefix ComfyUI's API export gives them). 'Plan the song structure' toggles YuE2GenerateABC in place of the empty ABC the music node accepts; the 32-step dpm_2 / sgm_uniform sampler is the template's.

inputs.label: Style
inputs.default: upbeat indie pop with warm female vocals, bright electric guitars, punchy drums, 120 bpm
inputs.help: Instruments, genre, mood, tempo; the model reads it as tags.

inputs.label: Lyrics
inputs.default:
[Verse]
Morning light across the window
City waking down below
I can hear the streets are calling
Feels like somewhere we should go

[Chorus]
Run with me into the sunlight
Leave the shadows far behind
inputs.help: Section tags in brackets ([Verse], [Chorus]); leave empty for an instrumental.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The template runs 32; fewer steps are faster and rougher.

inputs.label: Plan the structure first
inputs.help: YuE2GenerateABC lays the song out (verse, chorus, bridge) before the music model runs: better long songs, slower.

notes: YuE2 generates the song and its vocals together: the style is read as tags, the lyrics keep their [Verse] / [Chorus] sections, and an empty lyric sheet gives an instrumental. One checkpoint holds the text-to-music model and its decoder. The weights are CC BY-NC 4.0: personal use only, no commercial output.
